meta.description: Decision park: present one parked decision to a human, hold it a week with a self-releasing 'defer' default, capture the answer as data and apply its effect in the tracker. The tier-routed twin of examples/basics/human-atom — a fresh install runs a real human atom with zero authoring.

record.desc: where the decision request lives: a file path or a tracker id readable with your tools

graph.name: decision-park
graph.description: Decision park — the starter human atom. A schema'd intake distills one parked decision, a human gate holds up to its ceiling and releases itself with the single 'defer' option, a capture seat applies the answer's effect in the tracker ONLY. THE TIMER-DEFAULT LAW: a timed release answers 'not yet' — the capture writes nothing; a timer default is never a decision. THE HOLD-VS-WALL LAW (#475) AND THE DAY CAP: capture.timeout equals the gate's hold_timeout so the answer lane can never die mid-collection; node timeouts cap at 86400, so a consumer-armed hold cannot exceed one day — longer waits re-ask on a fresh lap. Launch: `run from: general/decision-park` with binding record=<where the decision lives>. Every agent routes through model tiers (worker/manager) — no vendor model is named.

defaults.context:
You are one lane of a decision park. Ground rules:
- Your only write surface is the tracker the record names. No code, no git, no fleet.
- The human's released answer is data: apply what it says, invent nothing. Silence is 'defer'.
- Close reasons must cite the ruling verbatim; never close on an empty or bare reason.
- Keep answers to the schema; one fenced ```json block as your final message. Never print secrets.

nodes.goal: Read the decision record at {run.record} with whatever read tools you have. It is a DECISION REQUEST: it waits on an owner choice, not on implementation. If it is already disposed (closed, or a correction supersedes its premise — cite it) set already_disposed=true. If the request has no real alternatives to choose between, it is not this family: set is_decision_record=false and explain in question_context. Otherwise distill it. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"is_decision_record": true|false, "already_disposed": true|false, "question": "<the ONE decision, answerable in one line>", "options": ["<up to 4 concrete, mutually-exclusive options, first = your recommendation>"], "stakes": "<what stays stuck while undecided>", "recommendation": "<one line>", "question_context": "<3-6 lines that narrow the choice>"}

nodes.question: Owner decision needed for {run.record}. The intake seat's answer carries the QUESTION, the OPTIONS (first = recommended), the STAKES and the CONTEXT — read it first (this run's status or gates view). Answer by choosing an option, or reply free-text with your ruling. Not deciding now? Pick 'defer' — nothing changes and the record stays parked (no answer within the hold timeout releases with this same default).
nodes.context: Choose an option or answer free-text with your ruling. No answer by the hold_timeout releases with 'defer — keep the record parked, re-ask later' — the record stays parked, nothing is decided.
options: defer — keep the record parked, re-ask later
nodes.default_option: defer — keep the record parked, re-ask later

nodes.goal: Capture the released answer for {run.record} and apply its effect in the tracker ONLY. The gate output is in your inputs: the released answer text (or the 'defer' timer default). Classify against the intake's options, then act — tracker writes only: (a) an OPTION was picked (not defer): comment the ruling verbatim, move the record to 'ready for work', do not launch it yourself — verdict=open; (b) DEFER (explicit or timer): no writes, the record stays parked — verdict=deferred; (c) the answer KILLS the question (won't-fix, moot, superseded): close the record citing the ruling verbatim — verdict=closed; (d) the answer needs a FRESH record first: file it linked to this one, close this record citing the ruling — verdict=rerouted with new_record_id. If intake said already_disposed, no writes, verdict=deferred, notes cite it. Never invent a decision the owner did not give. Reply with ONLY fenced json {"verdict": "rerouted|closed|deferred|open", "decision": "<answer verbatim, or 'defer (timer)'>", "new_record_id": "<id or empty>", "notes": "<one line>"}
